patched = []

            print(f"ALREADY PATCHED: {fpath}")
        else:
            print(f"SKIPPED (no match): {fpath}")

if not patched:
    print("WARNING: No files needed patching!")
else:
    print(f"\nTotal patched: {len(patched)}")
EOF
